title: Optimized MobileNetV1 with Channel Attention for Yarn Package Defect Detection
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and National Chiao Tung University

detail.title: Optimized MobileNetV1 with Channel Attention for Yarn Package Defect Detection
detail.abstract: Accurate inspection of yarn packages is critical in the textile industry to prevent production losses and equipment damage. Recent work has integrated the Channel Attention Block (CABs) into the MobileNetV1 architecture to enhance defect detection performance. Building on that foundation, this study extends the network depth to 13 layers and embeds CABs between convolutional blocks, guided by extensive ablation studies to refine the design. The system targets four common defect types—wound-in waste, spillover, cobwebs, and dirt—and is trained on a real-world dataset collected from an operational textile factory. To further improve detection accuracy, we apply image preprocessing techniques including Difference of Gaussian (DoG) filtering and block reorientation via interpolation. The proposed method achieves 95.9% precision for normal packages, 80.19% precision for defective packages, and an overall accuracy of 91.53%. These results demonstrate the system’s robustness and practicality for automated visual inspection in yarn packages.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过将通道注意力模块嵌入到13层MobileNetV1架构中，结合DoG滤波和图像重定向预处理技术，实现了纱线包缺陷检测系统，在真实纺织工厂数据集上达到91.53%的整体准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过深度网络架构优化和图像预处理技术提高纱线包缺陷检测的准确率？
AI.motivation: 纺织行业中纱线包的准确检测对于防止生产损失和设备损坏至关重要，现有方法在检测精度方面仍有提升空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于MobileNetV1架构，集成通道注意力机制(CABs)，应用计算机视觉中的DoG滤波和图像重定向技术。
AI.method: 将网络深度扩展到13层，在卷积块之间嵌入CABs模块，采用DoG滤波和基于插值的块重定向进行图像预处理，针对四种常见缺陷类型进行训练。
AI.findings: 正常包检测精度95.9%，缺陷包检测精度80.19%，整体准确率91.53%，证明了系统的鲁棒性和实用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了深度网络与注意力机制结合的缺陷检测架构，验证了图像预处理技术对检测性能的提升作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了适用于纺织工厂实际应用的自动化视觉检测系统，能够有效识别纱线包中的常见缺陷类型。

title: Optimization of Aero-Engine Blade Arrangement Considering Manufacturing–Assembly Integrated Errors
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

detail.title: Optimization of Aero-Engine Blade Arrangement Considering Manufacturing–Assembly Integrated Errors
detail.abstract: This study addresses rotor imbalance caused by cumulative error transmission during aero-engine blade assembly and investigates optimization of blade arrangement. Based on an analysis of manufacturing and assembly errors of the disk and blades, a transmission model linking blade mass moments, disk eccentricity, and assembly angle deviations was developed. A mathematical expression for the blade centroid under combined errors and a corresponding rotor-unbalance modeling approach were proposed, enabling a quantitative description of the error-transmission mechanism. A genetic algorithm was applied to the blade-arrangement optimization problem. A fitness function minimizing the rotor’s residual unbalance was constructed, and optimization iterations were performed using actual blade measurement data to obtain an optimal arrangement. The proposed method was compared with sector-wise alternating heavy-light distribution and exhaustive search. Experimental results indicate that the comprehensive-error genetic optimization significantly reduces rotor unbalance: in dynamic-balancing tests, the vibration amplitude decreased by 39.43% relative to the sector-wise alternating method. These results demonstrate that the proposed error-transmission modeling combined with GA-based optimization effectively improves blade-arrangement rationality and rotor dynamic-balance performance, providing theoretical support and experimental validation for the formulation and optimization of aero-engine blade assembly processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对航空发动机叶片装配过程中累计误差传递导致的转子不平衡问题，开发了误差传递模型和遗传算法优化方法，显著降低了转子不平衡量，振动幅值比扇形交替法减少39.43%。
AI.research_question: 如何优化航空发动机叶片排列以解决转子不平衡问题？
AI.motivation: 航空发动机叶片装配过程中累计误差传递导致的转子不平衡问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 叶片质量矩、盘偏心度和装配角偏差的传递模型，转子不平衡建模方法
AI.method: 基于遗传算法的叶片排列优化，构建最小化转子残余不平衡的适应度函数
AI.findings: 综合误差遗传优化显著降低转子不平衡，动态平衡测试中振动幅值比扇形交替法减少39.43%
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了叶片质心在组合误差下的数学表达式和相应的转子不平衡建模方法，实现了误差传递机制的定量描述
AI.practical_contributions: 为航空发动机叶片装配工艺的制定和优化提供了理论支持和实验验证，有效提高了叶片排列合理性和转子动平衡性能

title: A PRÁXIS DA COOPERAÇÃO: EVIDÊNCIAS EMPÍRICAS DA COMPLEMENTARIDADE ENTRE A TEORIA DA AÇÃO COLETIVA EA GESTÃO DE CUSTOS INTERORGANIZACIONAL
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Universidade Federal do Paraná

detail.title: A PRÁXIS DA COOPERAÇÃO: EVIDÊNCIAS EMPÍRICAS DA COMPLEMENTARIDADE ENTRE A TEORIA DA AÇÃO COLETIVA EA GESTÃO DE CUSTOS INTERORGANIZACIONAL
detail.abstract: Tanto a Teoria da Ação Coletiva quanto a literatura sobre Gestão de Custos Interorganizacionais têm discutido as origens e a evolução dos relacionamentos interorganizacionais, sua influência e efeitos sobre os agentes de mercado, e os fatores que os determinam e modificam. O objetivo deste estudo foi compreender as similaridades e complementaridades entre a Teoria da Ação Coletiva e a Gestão de Custos Interorganizacionais, a fim de destacar pontos de discussão relacionados ao desenvolvimento regional. Foi realizado um estudo qualitativo em uma cooperativa de pequenos produtores rurais, utilizando entrevistas e observações. Os resultados mostraram que a Teoria da Ação Coletiva se preocupa com o valor gerado a partir dos benefícios e custos individuais da cooperação, e a Gestão de Custos Interorganizacionais com o produto. Conclui-se que ambas explicam os contextos econômico e social da cooperativa e podem contribuir para as discussões relacionadas ao desenvolvimento regional, sendo semelhantes e complementares em alguns aspectos.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了集体行动理论与跨组织成本管理之间的相似性和互补性，重点关注其对区域发展的影响。通过小型农村生产者合作社的案例研究，发现两种理论分别关注合作产生的个体价值和组织产品，能够共同解释合作社的经济和社会背景。
AI.research_question: 集体行动理论与跨组织成本管理之间在区域发展相关讨论中的相似性和互补性是什么？
AI.motivation: 集体行动理论和跨组织成本管理文献都讨论了跨组织关系的起源和演变、对市场参与者的影响以及决定和改变这些关系的因素，但两者之间的关系尚未充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集体行动理论、跨组织成本管理理论
AI.method: 在小型农村生产者合作社进行的定性研究，采用访谈和观察方法
AI.findings: 集体行动理论关注从合作中产生的个体利益和成本的个体价值，而跨组织成本管理关注产品；两者都能解释合作社的经济和社会背景
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了集体行动理论与跨组织成本管理之间的相似性和互补性，为理解跨组织关系提供了整合的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域发展相关讨论提供了理论支持，特别是在小型农村合作社等集体组织形式中

title: A Fault-Diagnosis Algorithm for Gas Pressure
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Jiangsu University of Science and Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Fault-Diagnosis Algorithm for Gas Pressure
detail.abstract: Gas pressure regulators play a critical role in urban gas distribution networks, and accurate fault prediction is essential for ensuring system safety and reducing maintenance costs. This paper reviews recent advances in gas-pressure-regulator fault prediction and exposes the limitations of traditional approaches in terms of accuracy and timeliness. Deep-learning methods have improved performance, yet practical deployment still faces obstacles such as multi-modal data fusion, long-range dependency modelling and lightweight implementation on edge hardware. To address these issues, we put forward an enhanced prediction framework based on the EMD–LSTM–LSO architecture. The model first applies Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) to adaptively extract intrinsic mode functions from non-stationary time-series data, then employs a multi-layer Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to capture temporal dynamics, while a Lion Swarm Optimizer (LSO) automatically tunes network hyper-parameters for optimum generalisation. Experiments on real-world regulator data show that the proposed method surpasses conventional techniques in prediction accuracy, early-warning capability and false-alarm suppression, providing a robust and practical solution for predictive maintenance in smart gas systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于EMD-LSTM-LSO架构的燃气调压器故障预测框架，通过经验模态分解、长短期记忆网络和狮群优化器的结合，解决了多模态数据融合、长程依赖建模和边缘硬件轻量化部署等挑战，在真实数据上验证了其在预测精度、早期预警和误报抑制方面的优越性能。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个准确、及时且轻量化的燃气调压器故障预测框架，以克服传统方法和深度学习方法的局限性？
AI.motivation: 燃气调压器在城市燃气配网中至关重要，传统故障预测方法在准确性和及时性方面存在局限，深度学习方法虽有所改进，但在多模态数据融合、长程依赖建模和边缘硬件部署方面仍面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经验模态分解(EMD)的非平稳时间序列分析理论、长短期记忆网络(LSTM)的时序建模理论、狮群优化器(LSO)的超参数优化理论。
AI.method: 提出EMD-LSTM-LSO三阶段框架：1) EMD自适应提取非平稳时间序列的本征模态函数；2) 多层LSTM网络捕捉时序动态；3) LSO自动优化网络超参数以实现最佳泛化性能。
AI.findings: 在真实调压器数据上的实验表明，所提方法在预测精度、早期预警能力和误报抑制方面均优于传统技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了EMD-LSTM-LSO集成框架，有效结合了信号分解、时序建模和优化算法；2) 解决了非平稳时间序列分析中的多模态数据融合和长程依赖建模问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能燃气系统的预测性维护提供了一个鲁棒且实用的解决方案，具有在边缘硬件上轻量化部署的潜力。

title: Interaction between Workers and Automated Guided Vehicles: Validation of Worker State Prediction and eHMI Design
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: Interaction between Workers and Automated Guided Vehicles: Validation of Worker State Prediction and eHMI Design
detail.abstract: Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) are increasingly integrated into manufacturing to optimize material transport and support workers, and much prior work has emphasized path-planning for fixed routes. As AGVs transition to sensor- and prediction-driven operation in dynamic, human-shared spaces, understanding the interaction between AGVs and human workers becomes critical. We contrast two communication modes: (i) implicit communication, where the AGV predicts human motion and adapts its behavior accordingly, and (ii) explicit communication, where the AGV conveys its intent via an external human–machine interface (eHMI). Building on a previously developed prediction algorithm, Study 1 generated light-based eHMI designs through an online survey and internal evaluation to communicate AGV intentions. Study 2 evaluated interaction in a within-subjects virtual-reality testbed across three conditions-Control (current practice), Prediction (AGV equipped with the prediction algorithm), and eHMI+Prediction (AGV equipped with both eHMI and the prediction algorithm)-using objective safety metrics and subjective ratings (trust, perceived safety, perceived performance, understandability). Objectively, Prediction and eHMI+Prediction conditions significantly reduced slowdown zone entries relative to the Control condition. The eHMI+Prediction condition also marginally reduced stopping-zone entries. Subjectively, eHMI+Prediction condition showed higher ratings of trust, perceived safety, and perceived performance compared to the Control condition, whereas the Prediction condition alone did not improve trust or perceived safety. Understandability did not differ across conditions, suggesting that abstract light cues may require training. Overall, utilizing both predictive adaptation with explicit eHMI yielded safer, more trusted, and higher perceived performance than prediction alone, offering practical guidance for deploying AGVs in dynamic, worker-shared environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了AGV在动态人机共享环境中的两种通信模式：隐式通信（基于预测算法）和显式通信（通过外部人机界面）。研究发现，结合预测算法和eHMI的混合模式在客观安全指标和主观信任感知方面均优于单独使用预测算法。
AI.research_question: 在动态的人机共享环境中，AGV的隐式通信（基于预测）和显式通信（通过eHMI）哪种模式能更有效地提升安全性和人机信任？
AI.motivation: 随着AGV从固定路线转向传感器和预测驱动的动态操作，理解AGV与人类工人之间的交互变得至关重要，特别是在人机共享空间中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机交互理论、通信模式理论（隐式vs显式通信）、信任建立机制
AI.method: 研究1：通过在线调查和内部评估生成基于光的eHMI设计；研究2：在虚拟现实环境中进行被试内设计，比较三种条件（控制组、预测组、eHMI+预测组），使用客观安全指标和主观评分。
AI.findings: 客观上：预测组和eHMI+预测组显著减少了减速区进入次数；eHMI+预测组边际减少了停止区进入次数。主观上：eHMI+预测组在信任、感知安全和感知性能方面评分更高；单独预测组未改善信任或感知安全；可理解性在各条件下无差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在动态人机环境中结合隐式和显式通信的混合交互模式理论框架，深化了对AGV人机信任建立机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在动态工人共享环境中部署AGV提供了实用指导：建议同时采用预测算法和eHMI，而非单独依赖预测算法，以提升安全性和工人接受度。

title: Green incentives and OFDI: Evidence from China’s green factory policy
affiliations: Shanghai University of International Business and Economics, Shandong University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Green incentives and OFDI: Evidence from China’s green factory policy
detail.abstract: This study explores how the green factory policy of China impact firms’ outward foreign investment. Employing the multi-period difference-in-differences method, our research uncovers that the green factory policy has substantially enhanced firm outward direct investment. We demonstrate that this policy primarily influences firm outward direct investment through two critical channels: the green signal effect and the mitigation of financing constraints. The heterogeneity analysis reveals that the green factory policy is more effective in stimulating greenfield investments rather than cross-border mergers and acquisitions. Moreover, the green factory policy exerts a stronger stimulative effect on the outward direct investment of firms in traditionally heavy-polluting industries and non-state-owned firms. This study offers fresh empirical evidence on the role of environmental incentives in shaping the trajectory of outward direct investment.

AI.tldr: 中国绿色工厂政策显著促进了企业对外直接投资，主要通过绿色信号效应和缓解融资约束两个渠道实现，对绿地投资、重污染行业和非国有企业的促进作用更强。
AI.research_question: 中国绿色工厂政策如何影响企业对外直接投资？
AI.motivation: 探讨环境激励政策在塑造对外直接投资轨迹中的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色信号效应理论、融资约束理论
AI.findings: 绿色工厂政策显著促进企业对外直接投资；主要通过绿色信号效应和缓解融资约束两个渠道；对绿地投资、重污染行业和非国有企业促进作用更强
AI.theory_contributions: 为环境激励政策影响对外直接投资提供了新的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计环境激励政策提供了参考，帮助企业理解绿色政策对国际投资的影响

title: Autonomous, electrified vehicles can drive down personal aviation demand
affiliations: Centre for Applied Macroeconomic Analysis, ANU

detail.title: Autonomous, electrified vehicles can drive down personal aviation demand
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the potential long-run effects of autonomous and electric vehicles, and a carbon tax, on personal domestic aviation demand in Australia. We estimate a discrete choice disutility model with two travel modes — car and air — using Australian National Visitor Survey data and Bayesian priors. We use multiplicative Fréchet errors, consistent with a constant elasticity of substitution utility function for a representative consumer of both modes. An elasticity of substitution of almost 4 replicates the observed transition to air travel as distances increase. Combining in turn electrification, autonomy, the use of overnight robotaxis, a 10 kph increase in average car speeds, and an AUS$200/tCO2e carbon tax leads to air passenger reductions of 5%, 19%, 22%, 28% and 43%, respectively. Reductions are highest for shorter flights, so aggregate emissions do not decline as much as passenger numbers, while the number of aircraft trips declines more.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动驾驶和电动汽车以及碳税对澳大利亚国内航空需求的长期影响。通过离散选择模型分析，发现这些技术变革和政策能显著减少航空乘客数量，特别是短途航班，但对整体排放的减少效果不如乘客数量减少明显。
AI.research_question: 自动驾驶和电动汽车以及碳税对澳大利亚国内航空需求的长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究新兴交通技术和环境政策如何改变人们的出行选择，特别是对航空需求的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于离散选择效用模型，采用乘法Fréchet误差，符合代表性消费者对两种交通方式的恒定替代弹性效用函数。
AI.method: 使用澳大利亚国家访客调查数据和贝叶斯先验，估计离散选择负效用模型，分析汽车和航空两种出行方式。
AI.findings: 电气化、自动驾驶、夜间机器人出租车使用、平均车速提高10公里/小时以及200澳元/吨二氧化碳碳税分别导致航空乘客减少5%、19%、22%、28%和43%。短途航班减少最多，但总体排放减少不如乘客数量减少明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于离散选择模型的交通方式替代分析框架，验证了恒定替代弹性效用函数在交通需求预测中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化评估新兴交通技术和碳税对航空需求影响的方法，有助于制定更有效的交通和环境政策。
